geometry_resolution.description: Each initially unresolved FOV geometry was reassessed from its persisted, SHA256-validated v4 source state.  A final category requires consistent supports; records unresolved at 96/240/2 are UNCERTIFIED_AT_CAP rather than interpreted as origin-enclosure evidence.

hopf_vs_turing.scope_caveat: This is a 64x64 screen with BE dt=1; Hopf reaches t=20 and Turing reaches t=200, below the 256x256 target scale. The FOV values use the dt=1 BE operator.
hopf_vs_turing.statement: Both evolved regimes are indeterminate at every sampled FFT-preconditioned state in this screen. The corroborated FOV diagnostics enclose the origin at every sampled FFT-preconditioned state. The Hopf imaginary extent grows over the samples, but it is not larger than the Turing extent at every sample.
